# 2011-12 Harvard Crimson Men's Basketball Team

## Overview
The 2011-12 season was a historic one for Harvard basketball, as the Crimson won their second consecutive Ivy League championship and made their second straight NCAA Tournament appearance.

## Season Record
- **Overall Record**: 26-5
- **Ivy League Record**: 12-2 (tied for first place)
- **Head Coach**: Tommy Amaker (6th season)

## Key Accomplishments
- **Ivy League Champions** (shared with Princeton)
- Won the Ivy League tournament/playoff to earn the NCAA Tournament bid
- Reached the **NCAA Tournament** (received a #14 seed)
- First NCAA Tournament win in school history, defeating #3 seed New Mexico 68-62
- Lost to #11 seed Vanderbilt in the Round of 64

## Notable Players
- **Kyle Casey** - Junior forward, one of the team's leading scorers
- **Keith Wright** - Senior center and team captain, leading scorer and rebounder
- **Laurent Rivard** - Sharpshooter guard
- **Brandyn Curry** - Point guard
- **Oliver McNally** - Guard

## Historic NCAA Tournament Win
The victory over New Mexico marked Harvard's first-ever NCAA Tournament win in school history, a major milestone for the program. This game showcased Harvard's ability to compete with highly-ranked opponents on college basketball's biggest stage.

This season continued Harvard's emergence as a legitimate basketball program under Tommy Amaker's leadership.
